notes.title: FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36222652/299141ff77734db77a7b6d75c9ba355bdb965640.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Remote Play Together[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Q：What is Remote Play Together? How to use it?[/b][/h3]
A: Remote Play Together function is provided by Steam, once you have a game, you can play with your remotely online. This function is also build-in the DUMB FIGHT. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1054720/announcements/detail/1708485147044584532]Look here for more information about Remote Play Together[/url]

[h3][b]Q：How to solve the delay problem when using Remote Play Together.[/b][/h3]
A: While using Remote Play Together, an orange or Red sign will appeal at the right bottom corner of your screen if the connection is unstable. This is a Steam build-in function, might differ from different regions. 
If you encounter an unstable connection, you may follow the solution provided by Valve to improve:
[list]
[*] [b]Hardware:[/b]
We recommend a minimum of a quad-core CPU for the computer running the game. The client has more modest requirements, but should have a GPU that supports hardware accelerated H264 decoding. Any recent laptop or PC should meet the client requirements.
[*] [b]Network:[/b]
We recommend using a wired network for the best streaming experience. People have had some success with powerline networks and wireless N and AC networks with good signal, though your experience may vary.
[*] [b]Game Settings:[/b]
To improve your streaming experience, you can go into your game settings and lower your resolution and turn off vertical sync.
[*] [b]Steam Settings:[/b] 
In the Remote Play settings you can change a number of things that can affect your experience. You can change your preference for speed vs quality, limit the network bandwidth, and adjust the maximum capture resolution.
[/list]
[url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3629-RIAV-1617#improvement]Please look at the Valve solution information here[/url]

[h3][b]Q：Why is my keyboard controlled by others?[/b][/h3]
A：When using Remote Play, your keyboard will be identified as a shared device. Please make sure you and other players are using different parts of the keyboard, or use another controller to avoid this problem.

[h1][b]Control of keyboard and controller[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Q：How many players can play with one keyboard? [/b][/h3]
A: Currently one keyboard can support up to 4 players.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1054720/partnerevents/view/1706236518827517522](Keyboard controlling Guideline)[/url]

[h3][b]Q：I am not familiar with the key configuration, can I modify?[/b][/h3]
A：Sorry, currently our game does not allow personalize keyboard configuration. We are working on it, thank you for your patient.

[h3][b]Q：Why is my controller not reacting?[/b][/h3]
A: If your controller can react normally in other games, please follow the instruction below:
[olist]
[*] Open Steam application, click "Steam" on the left upper corner, and go to "Settings"
[*] Go to "Controller" and choose "General Controller Settings"
[*] Put a "Check Mark" on the controller type.
[*] Check the wire link between computer and controller, all devices detected will appeal.
[*] Finish setting.  
[/olist]
[url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/getting_started_for_players?l=tchinese]Look at more information from Valve[/url]


[h3][b]Q：How many controllers do I need to paly with 8 players.[/b][/h3]
A：Your keyboard can provide up to 4 players, to play with 8 players, you will only need 4 extra controllers. Or you may also play with 8 controllers.

[h1][b]Others[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Q：How many players suit best for this game?[/b][/h3]
A：We suggest 4-8 players can have a better game experience. 

[h3][b]Q：Will there be an online connection function?[/b][/h3]
A：Our team is working on a related feature, will release an Alpha version that supports online connection sooner or later.

notes.title: supports Steam feature, "Remote Play Together"!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36222652/a4d065c138e6e5406ccdde62bd883672aecdfd30.png[/img]

《DUMB FIGHT》supports Steam brand new feature, the "Remote Play Together"!

Even though 《DUMB FIGHT》 does not have an online multiplayer feature, but you are able to play with faraway friends at home through the "Remote Play Together" function supported by Steam.

All you need is one pack of 《DUMB FIGHT》, friends can play with you remotely.

For more detail, please look at the Steam official introduction.
*Remind: This feature is provided by Steam officially.

[h2][b]Steps to Remote Play with friends[/b][/h2]

[h1][b]1.Launch DUMB FIGHT[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]2.Invite Friend[/b][/h1]
1.Use Shift+Tab to call out the Steam embedded interface
2.View friends
3.Right-click on your online friend
4.Send remote play invitation
5.Wait for friend's acceptance

[h1][b]3.Enjoy DUMB FIGHT with your friend[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]※Please be aware[/b][/h3]
When using Remote Play, the keyboard of the main host (the computer that owns and launch the game) will be shared with other remote players. To enable more than one player using the same keyboard, please modify each one's control access to a different key position. (A keyboard supports 4 players)


Please look at here for more information (From Steam official)：
https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687
